usage: This is a progressive-context (pcx) manifest: a compact, navigable index of a much larger body of content, meant to be read under a small token budget. You are seeing descriptors, NOT full content. Each node has `what` (what it is), `when` (when it is relevant), a token cost, and either `children` (a branch) or a `payload` (a leaf). To find what you need: (1) scan the descriptors under `root.children`; (2) follow the node whose `when` best matches your goal; (3) for a branch, look up its child ids in `nodes` to go deeper; (4) for a leaf, fetch the full verbatim content by resolving `payload.ref` (e.g. `node://<id>`) — a leaf's content is not in this file. A node may also carry `links` (see-also references `{to, why}` to related nodes in OTHER branches — follow them to explore laterally) and `facets` (a map of orthogonal tags like type/status — filter on these to narrow before reading descriptors). Expand only what you need and stay within `variant.budget` tokens. If your host exposes navigation tools (index / open / look / related / filter), prefer those; otherwise resolve `node://` refs yourself.

root.title: Faro catalog
root.what: Route requests to the right data and media tool
root.when: You need a broad starting point to pick the right content or data capability

cat-audio-video.title: Audio & Video
cat-audio-video.when: Need transcript, speakers, timestamps, chapters, or video generation/editing

skill-audio-intelligence.title: Audio Intelligence
skill-audio-intelligence.what: Turns a recording into a structured transcript, labeling who said what and optionally chaptering it.
skill-audio-intelligence.when: You have a recording and need its words as text, with speaker turns and optional chapter summaries. Not for: Live or streaming captioning, translation, naming the actual speakers, or detecting sentiment, entities, or sensitive content.

skill-speech-to-text.title: Speech to Text
skill-speech-to-text.what: Transcribes the speech in an audio file to text, multilingual, on Faro's own infrastructure.
skill-speech-to-text.when: You have an audio file and need its spoken words as text. Not for: Generating speech from text, translating, separating speakers, or analyzing non-speech audio.

skill-video.title: Video
skill-video.what: Finds, generates, and edits video, routing the request to the right approach.
skill-video.when: You need a video, whether to find real stock footage, generate a new clip, or edit one you have. Not for: Pure audio work, transcription, reading text out of a video, or live streaming.

cat-business-companies.title: Business & Companies
cat-business-companies.what: Lookup company and contact business data
cat-business-companies.when: Need company identity, firmographics, contacts, or verify emails/phones

skill-company-data.title: Company Data
skill-company-data.what: Returns a company's firmographics plus sourced signals like funding, hiring, technology, news, and open source, all by domain.
skill-company-data.when: You have a company's website or name and want structured facts about it and the live signals around it. Not for: Finding companies you cannot yet name, people or contact details, live stock prices or regulatory filings, or company logos.

skill-company-logo.title: Company Logo
skill-company-logo.what: Resolves a company domain or brand name to its canonical name, primary domain, and a hosted logo image URL.
skill-company-logo.when: You need a company's logo image or its official domain to enrich a record, render an avatar, or build autocomplete. Not for: Brand colors or fonts, firmographics like employees or revenue, designing a new logo, or verifying that a company is legitimate.

skill-contact-data.title: Contact Data
skill-contact-data.what: Finds people at a company (names and titles, or with verified work emails and phone numbers) and verifies emails/phones for people you already know.
skill-contact-data.when: You need decision-makers at a target company (with or without their contact details), or a verified work email or phone for a known person. Not for: Consumer or personal contact data, residential phones, profiling someone by name with no employer, or company firmographics by domain (use Company Data).

skill-email-verification.title: Email Verification
skill-email-verification.what: Checks whether one email address is real and likely to receive mail, with a deliverability score and risk flags.
skill-email-verification.when: You need to confirm a single address is deliverable before sending to it, accepting it at signup, or trusting it. Not for: Sending or delivering mail, bulk-list batch verification, finding or discovering addresses, user login, spam-content scanning, or replacing a real confirmation email.

skill-phone.title: Phone Number Tools
skill-phone.what: Parses a phone number into its parts and reformats it to a standard form.
skill-phone.when: You need to validate, inspect, or normalize a phone number. Not for: Looking up a number's owner, carrier lookups, or sending messages.

skill-vat-validation.title: VAT Validation
skill-vat-validation.what: Confirms whether one EU VAT number is real against the official EU registry and returns the registered business name and address.
skill-vat-validation.when: You need to confirm an EU VAT number is valid and registered before invoicing, zero-rating a cross-border supply, or trusting a business. Not for: UK VAT numbers, US tax IDs or sales tax, format or checksum only validation, tax rate lookups, full company data enrichment, or batch lists.

cat-developer-tools.title: Developer Tools
cat-developer-tools.when: Need exact numeric, encoding, UUID, random, data store, wait, or unit conversion

skill-calc-evaluate.title: Calculator
skill-calc-evaluate.what: Evaluates arithmetic exactly, converts numbers between bases, and converts Roman numerals.
skill-calc-evaluate.when: You need exact arithmetic, base conversion, or Roman numerals the model should not eyeball. Not for: Symbolic math, unit conversion (use units), or word problems.

skill-encoding.title: Encoding
skill-encoding.what: Hashes, base64/URL encodes or decodes, generates UUIDs, and decodes JWTs, exactly.
skill-encoding.when: You need an exact digest, encoded string, UUID, or JWT payload the model should not guess. Not for: Verifying a JWT signature, encrypting data, or decoding formats other than base64 or URL.

skill-hooks.title: Webhook Inbox
skill-hooks.what: Creates a throwaway inbox that captures incoming webhooks, then polls it for what arrived.
skill-hooks.when: You need a URL to receive webhooks or callbacks and read them back. Not for: Sending a request yourself, or scheduling an outgoing call (use schedule).

skill-kv.title: Key-Value Store
skill-kv.what: Stores, reads, and deletes small values by key, with an optional expiry.
skill-kv.when: You need to stash a small value between calls and read it back later by key. Not for: Large blobs or files (use the file share), or structured records you query (use tables).

skill-random.title: Random
skill-random.what: Generates unpredictable random integers, picks, shuffles, and strings from a secure source.
skill-random.when: You need genuine randomness the model cannot produce, like a dice roll, a pick, or a token. Not for: Reproducible or seeded sequences, statistical sampling with a fixed seed, or UUIDs (use encoding).

skill-tables.title: Tables
skill-tables.what: Stores records in a collection and filters, searches, updates, counts, or deletes them.
skill-tables.when: You need a small structured store you can query by field or search by meaning. Not for: A single value by key (use the key-value store), or a file (use the file share).

skill-timer.title: Wait
skill-timer.what: Pauses for a set number of seconds, then continues.
skill-timer.when: You need a real inline delay for pacing a polling loop, retry backoff, or rate-limiting. Not for: Firing an action later without blocking, or waits longer than 30 seconds (use schedule).

skill-units.title: Unit Converter
skill-units.what: Converts a value between physical units and lists units by dimension.
skill-units.when: You need an exact unit conversion the model should not approximate. Not for: Currency conversion (use currency) or plain arithmetic (use calc).

cat-documents.title: Documents
cat-documents.when: Need PDF/DOC conversion, extraction, OCR, rendering, or document editing

skill-archive.title: Archive
skill-archive.what: Packs files into a zip, extracts a zip or 7z archive, or lists an archive's entries.
skill-archive.when: You need to bundle files into one download, unpack an archive, or see what is inside one. Not for: tar, gz, or rar archives, creating 7z files, password-protected archives, or converting file formats.

skill-document-converter.title: Document Converter
skill-document-converter.what: Converts one document between Markdown, Word, HTML, PDF, EPUB, and other text and markup formats, returning a download link.
skill-document-converter.when: You have one file in one format and need it in another, e.g. Markdown to Word, HTML to PDF, or a Word doc back to clean Markdown. Not for: Reading text or tables out of a PDF, OCR of scanned pages, math or citations rendered into a PDF, branded or templated Word from a corporate reference doc, spreadsheets or slide decks, or merging several files into one.

skill-email-extraction.title: Email Extraction
skill-email-extraction.what: Removes quoted history and replies from an email, returning just the new content with offsets to the original.
skill-email-extraction.when: You have a raw email and want only the new reply, e.g. to cut token cost before feeding it to a model. Not for: Generating or summarizing email, parsing attachments, or fetching mail from a provider (you supply the body).

skill-ocr.title: OCR
skill-ocr.what: Reads the text off a scanned or photographed document and returns it as layout-aware markdown, tables included.
skill-ocr.when: You have a scanned PDF or a photo of a document with no selectable text layer and need its contents as text. Not for: PDFs that already have a selectable text layer, answering questions about a document, describing photos, or translating.

skill-office-to-pdf.title: Office to PDF
skill-office-to-pdf.what: Renders Office, OpenDocument, and markup files to a layout-faithful PDF, routing by source type.
skill-office-to-pdf.when: You have a Word document, slide deck, spreadsheet, or HTML/text file and need a PDF of it. Not for: Extracting text or data from a file, editing or filling it, converting to anything but PDF, or merging and splitting PDFs.

skill-pdf.title: PDF
skill-pdf.what: Merges, splits, extracts text and tables, fills forms, stamps, and compresses PDFs, routing to the right job.
skill-pdf.when: You have one or more PDFs to combine, break apart, read, fill, watermark, or shrink. Not for: Reading scanned or photographed PDFs (OCR), creating a PDF from scratch or from Office files, encrypting, rotating, or redacting.

skill-tabular.title: Tabular
skill-tabular.what: Converts CSV, JSON, and XLSX between each other and reshapes a table by selecting columns, filtering rows, sorting, and limiting, returning a download link.
skill-tabular.when: You have a CSV, JSON, or XLSX file and need it in another of those formats, or trimmed to the columns and rows you want. Not for: Computing totals, averages, group-by, pivots, deduplication, joining files, renaming or deriving columns, running SQL or formulas, reading the values into your reasoning, or handling nested JSON, TSV, or Parquet.

skill-word-document.title: Word Document
skill-word-document.what: Builds a Microsoft Word (.docx) file from your content, with headings, paragraphs, lists, and tables.
skill-word-document.when: You want a finished .docx report, proposal, memo, letter, resume, minutes, or record created from your content. Not for: Editing, reading, or merging an existing .docx, PDF, slides, or spreadsheet, or adding letterhead, logos, footers, page numbers, or images.

cat-finance-markets.title: Finance & Markets
cat-finance-markets.what: Get market, economic, filing, and exchange data
cat-finance-markets.when: Need prices, tickers, exchanges, filings, macro indicators, or trading dates

skill-crypto.title: Crypto Prices
skill-crypto.what: Returns current price, market cap, volume, change, and history for coins and tokens, routing to the right lookup.
skill-crypto.when: You need a live, accurate crypto market reference instead of a stale guess from training data. Not for: Placing trades or moving funds, reading a wallet's balance or transactions, NFT floor prices, fiat exchange rates, or investment advice.

skill-currency.title: Currency Rates
skill-currency.what: Converts money between currencies and returns reference exchange rates for today, a past date, or a range.
skill-currency.when: You need an exchange rate or a currency conversion grounded in published reference rates instead of a guessed number. Not for: Live trading or dealer spreads, crypto prices, intraday or real-time tick rates, or rates for currencies outside the supported list.

skill-economic-data.title: Economic & Demographic Data
skill-economic-data.what: Returns exact official economic and demographic figures by place and year, resolving the request to the right series.
skill-economic-data.when: You need a precise economic or population statistic for a country or US geography instead of an approximate recalled number. Not for: Live market prices, company financials, forecasts or projections, and statistics for places or years the official sources do not cover.

skill-sec-filings.title: Company Filings & Fundamentals (US)
skill-sec-filings.what: Returns exact reported figures and filing metadata for US public companies from official disclosures.
skill-sec-filings.when: You need a real reported number or a filing record for a US-listed company, not an estimate. Not for: Stock prices or quotes, real-time news, analyst estimates, non-US or private companies, full filing text, or insider-trade line items.

skill-us-stocks.title: US Stocks
skill-us-stocks.what: Returns real historical price bars (open, high, low, close, volume) for US-listed stocks, daily or hourly.
skill-us-stocks.when: You need actual past US stock prices over a date range instead of made-up numbers, for one or many tickers. Not for: Live or latest quotes, sub-hourly or trade-level data, fundamentals, earnings, dividends, splits, news, analyst ratings, options, futures, crypto, forex, or non-US listings.

cat-images.title: Images
cat-images.when: Need to create, edit, enhance, inspect, or safety-check images

skill-content-moderation.title: Content Moderation
skill-content-moderation.what: Scores text and images across harm categories and returns a verdict before you act on content.
skill-content-moderation.when: You want to check user or generated content for unsafe material before showing, storing, or acting on it. Not for: Blocking or enforcement, reading text out of an image, virus or malware scanning, AI or deepfake detection, copyright or personal-data detection, or any legal reporting pipeline.

skill-image.title: Images
skill-image.what: Creates, finds, edits, and enhances images, routing the request to the right approach.
skill-image.when: You need an image, whether to generate one, find a real stock photo, or improve an existing image. Not for: Moderating images, reading text out of an image (OCR), making logos, or generating QR codes.

cat-knowledge-reference.title: Knowledge & Reference
cat-knowledge-reference.when: Use for factual lookups in curated databases and reference sources

skill-books.title: Books
skill-books.what: Looks up real bibliographic data for books by title, author, keyword, or ISBN.
skill-books.when: You need accurate book facts, the right edition, an ISBN, or an author's works instead of guessing from memory. Not for: Reading or borrowing full book text, buying or pricing books, author biographies or photos, reviews, ratings, or bestseller lists.

skill-case-law.title: Case Law
skill-case-law.what: Finds and reads real, citable US court opinions, dockets, and oral arguments.
skill-case-law.when: You need verifiable US case law to ground a legal citation, read a ruling, or pull a case record instead of trusting a hallucinated cite. Not for: Legal advice, foreign or international law, statutes and regulations, citation formatting, live court-filing purchases, or confirming a case is still good law.

skill-dictionary.title: Dictionary
skill-dictionary.what: Looks up real definitions, parts of speech, phonetics, pronunciation, synonyms, and examples for a word.
skill-dictionary.when: You need an authoritative definition or pronunciation of an English word instead of improvising one. Not for: Translating between languages, a thesaurus-first synonym dump, deep etymology, spell-correction, or a word-of-the-day.

skill-knowledge.title: Knowledge & Facts
skill-knowledge.what: Returns current, sourced facts from an encyclopedia and a structured knowledge base, instead of guessing.
skill-knowledge.when: You need a grounded, citable fact about a topic, person, place, or thing rather than recalling it from training data. Not for: General web search or current events, real-time data like prices or weather, scraping arbitrary URLs, or full article bodies.

skill-music.title: Music Metadata
skill-music.what: Identifies artists, albums, songs, and labels and returns their facts, relationships, and stable identifiers.
skill-music.when: You need authoritative music facts, like a discography, tracklist, band members, or who wrote a song. Not for: Playing or streaming audio, previews, lyrics, charts, sales or stream counts, playlists, or audio fingerprinting.

skill-nutrition.title: Nutrition
skill-nutrition.what: Returns real food and nutrition facts (calories, macros, ingredients) from authoritative sources.
skill-nutrition.when: You need verified calorie, macro, or ingredient numbers for a food or a packaged product instead of guessing. Not for: Personalized diet or medical advice, computing %DV or daily-value targets, summing a full dish across its ingredients, restaurant or menu items, or live food prices.

skill-space.title: Space & Science
skill-space.what: Returns NASA space data, routing to the daily astronomy image, asteroid approaches, or Mars rover photos.
skill-space.when: You want the Astronomy Picture of the Day, near-Earth asteroid approaches, or photos taken by a Mars rover. Not for: General web search, live launch schedules, satellite tracking, weather, star charts, or astrology.

skill-sports.title: Sports
skill-sports.what: Gets live scores, fixtures, results, and details for teams, leagues, players, and events across many sports.
skill-sports.when: You need current sports scores, upcoming fixtures, recent results, or real team and player facts instead of stale training data. Not for: Betting odds, predictions, win probabilities, statistics tables, injury news, standings tables, or play-by-play commentary.

skill-tv.title: TV Shows
skill-tv.what: Returns real television metadata, finding shows and people and pulling series details, episodes, cast, and schedules.
skill-tv.when: You need accurate, current facts about a TV series, its episodes, its cast, a TV actor, or what is airing on a date. Not for: Movies, where to stream a show or regional availability, aggregated critic ratings, personal watchlists, or plot recaps beyond the provided summary.

cat-maps-weather.title: Maps & Weather
cat-maps-weather.what: Lookup location, weather, and astronomy data
cat-maps-weather.when: Need places, maps, routes, forecasts, or sun/moon times

skill-astronomy.title: Sun and Moon Times
skill-astronomy.what: Computes sunrise, sunset, and twilight for a location, and the moon phase for a date.
skill-astronomy.when: You need exact daylight or moon-phase figures the model should not guess. Not for: Weather conditions or forecasts (use weather), or star and planet positions.

skill-maps.title: Maps
skill-maps.what: Turns addresses into coordinates and back, finds nearby places, and gives directions.
skill-maps.when: You need to resolve a location, label a coordinate, find places near a point, or get travel distance and time. Not for: Live traffic or transit schedules, map images or embeddable maps, device GPS or tracking, postal address validation, or bulk geocoding of large lists.

skill-weather.title: Weather
skill-weather.what: Gives current conditions and the forecast for any place, looking up coordinates from a name first.
skill-weather.when: You need live weather or a forecast for a location, by place name or by coordinates. Not for: Past or historical weather, climate normals, air quality, guaranteed severe-weather alerts, or safety-critical marine, aviation, or evacuation decisions.

cat-sharing.title: Sharing
cat-sharing.what: Share content with links, short URLs, snippets, and QR codes
cat-sharing.when: Choose when you already have a specific item and need to create a shareable link, short URL, snippet, or QR code for it

skill-files.title: File Share
skill-files.what: Shares a file at a download link with optional expiry, password, or one-time access, and revokes it.
skill-files.when: You need a temporary download link for a file or a URL's contents. Not for: A short text snippet (use the pastebin) or a small value by key (use the key-value store).

skill-link.title: URL Shortener
skill-link.what: Shortens a URL and reports click stats for a short code.
skill-link.when: You need a short link to share, or the click count for one you made. Not for: Hosting a file or page (use the file share or pastebin).

skill-paste.title: Pastebin
skill-paste.what: Stores a text snippet at a link with optional syntax, expiry, password, or one-time access, and deletes it.
skill-paste.when: You need to share a block of text or code at a link. Not for: Sharing a binary file (use the file share) or a small value by key (use the key-value store).

skill-qr-code.title: QR Code
skill-qr-code.what: Turns a URL, text, or structured payload like WiFi or a contact into a scannable QR code image.
skill-qr-code.when: You need a QR code someone can scan with a phone to open a link, join WiFi, save a contact, or read text. Not for: Reading or decoding an existing code, generating barcodes, tracking scans, or branded color and logo styling.

cat-time.title: Time
cat-time.what: Handle date, holiday, scheduling, and time zone tasks
cat-time.when: Choose for date or time reasoning, calendar math, holidays, deadlines, or time zones when you do not need live web lookup

skill-datetime.title: Date Calculator
skill-datetime.what: Computes date differences, shifts dates, and answers weekday and business-day questions.
skill-datetime.when: You need exact date arithmetic the model should not count by hand. Not for: Timezone conversion or current time (use timezone), or calendar holidays lookups (use holidays).

skill-holidays.title: Public Holidays
skill-holidays.what: Returns the real public-holiday calendar for a country, checks a date, finds upcoming holidays, and lists supported countries.
skill-holidays.when: You need accurate public holidays for scheduling, business-day logic, or to gate a job on a date instead of guessing. Not for: Company or personal calendars, religious-calendar conversion, long-weekend detection, event or concert dates, or weekend and business-day counting on their own.

skill-schedule.title: Scheduled Callback
skill-schedule.what: Schedules an HTTP callback to fire at a later time, and cancels a scheduled one.
skill-schedule.when: You need an action to happen later without blocking, or longer than a 30 second wait. Not for: Pausing inline right now (use timer), or sending a request immediately.

skill-timezone.title: Timezone Tools
skill-timezone.what: Gives the current time in a zone, converts times between zones, and describes a zone.
skill-timezone.when: You need the time in a specific timezone or an exact conversion between zones. Not for: Date arithmetic such as differences or shifts (use datetime).

cat-web-search.title: Web & Search
cat-web-search.what: Search and research the live web
cat-web-search.when: Choose when you need current web results, browsing, or cited research rather than a site-specific scraper or parser

skill-research.title: Research
skill-research.what: Answers questions with live, cited research, routing to the right depth for the job.
skill-research.when: You need a current, source-backed answer instead of guessing from stale training data. Not for: Pure chat or reasoning with no lookup, math or code generation, creative writing, or fetching one known URL's full content.

skill-site-scrapers.title: Site Scrapers
skill-site-scrapers.what: Pulls clean, structured records from specific platforms, routing to the right scraper for the target.
skill-site-scrapers.when: You need structured items from a known platform such as social, maps, marketplaces, reviews, jobs, listings, or video. Not for: Crawling arbitrary websites, pages behind your own login, or low-latency single lookups; use general web scraping or research for those.

skill-tech-stack.title: Tech Stack
skill-tech-stack.what: Detects the technologies a website runs, like its CMS, frameworks, servers, analytics, hosting, and payment tools.
skill-tech-stack.when: You want a per-site profile of the client-observable technologies one or more websites are built on. Not for: Finding companies that use a given technology, reading hidden backend databases or languages, historical adoption trends, or pages behind a login.

skill-web-scraping.title: Generic Scrapers
skill-web-scraping.what: Turns any public web page into clean, LLM-ready content or structured data, maps a site, unlocks blocked pages, and returns parsed search-engine results.
skill-web-scraping.when: You have a URL (or a site, or a search query) and need the real page content, specific fields off it, or what a search engine ranks, not a model guess. Not for: Platform-specific scrapers like LinkedIn, Amazon, or maps reviews (use Site Scrapers), open-web research to find URLs first (use Web Search), pages behind a personal login, or browser-automation scripting.

skill-web-search.title: Web Search
skill-web-search.what: Searches the live web and returns ranked results with titles, links, and snippets.
skill-web-search.when: You need fresh, external, or verifiable information from the live web rather than memory. Not for: Reading a full page's text, AI-synthesized cited answers, or image, video, or local-business search.
